Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 2, Verse 24

“It cannot be cut, cannot be burned, cannot be wetted or dried. It is eternal, all-pervading, stable, unmoving, everlasting.”

The same four denials restated as permanent qualities, then extended. The repetition is deliberate — Krishna is drilling the point into a mind that has just been shaking too hard to hold it.
